args.title: Update password reset email link to use correct base URL
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email link is currently pointing to localhost, which is not accessible to users. This change updates the BASE_URL to ensure that the link correctly refers to the public application URL instead of localhost.
